reuse.why: Uses the existing db helpers and link.findOrCreateBank; the new check is a single helper rather than per-provider queries.

duplication.why: Consolidates the five copied upgrade-or-create blocks into saveLinkedAccount; the per-provider sync/notify tail and the assert call itself remain repeated in each link function.

placement.why: The check and the shared save live in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers that use them.

scope.why: Extracting saveLinkedAccount goes beyond the request, but it is the code the check must guard and keeps the change coherent.

maintainability.why: One query defines what 'already linked' means and runs before any write; provider is typed as a plain string and each new provider must remember to call the assert.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers call assertBankAccountNotLinked and saveLinkedAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the copied blocks were removed into saveLinkedAccount.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts defines the rule; all five *-accounts-link handlers call it before saving.
